title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
description: Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way.

description: Maia hyper-fixates on the state of her life in Los Angeles while attempting to impress her boss, Alyssa; her carefully laid plans are upended by the surprise arrival of her chaotic friend Tallulah.

title: I Love LA
description: After reconciling, Maia and Tallulah step into their new roles as manager and client while tackling an increasingly erratic situation.

description: A tight-knit friend group gathers after years apart, navigating the complexities of ambition, relationships, and how time has changed them.

description: Maia tries to enjoy herself in New York; Tallulah contends with some questionable styling decisions; Alani plans a surprise for her parents' anniversary.

description: Marcella's stand-up comedy special at the Roulette Intermedium in Brooklyn, N.Y.

title: Sarah Squirm: Live + in the Flesh
description: Sarah Sherman's unholy alter ego, Sarah Squirm, unleashes a festering hour of bodily fluids, open-wound confessionals and jokes that will leave scars on the soul.

title: Amy Schumer: Live at the Apollo
description: The comic brings her unique blend of honesty and unapologetic sense of humor to a performance at the historic Apollo Theater in New York.

title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan
description: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate offers up razor-sharp reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.

title: Barbie
description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

title: Jesus Sepulveda: Mr. Tough Life
description: Jesus Sepulveda makes his standalone Entre Nos Presents debut with this comedy special recorded at Chelsea Music Hall.

description: Valerie is offered a role on a new multi-camera comedy; stoked that sitcoms are on a comeback, she accepts, but is shocked to discover that the show is being written by artificial intelligence.

title: The Comeback
description: Valerie attempts to out-improv the AI script, leading to a breakdown on set.

description: A leaked clip from Jane's documentary goes viral for all the wrong reasons.

description: Valerie Cherish is back; Lisa Kudrow stars as the determined former sitcom star trying to stay relevant in a changing industry filled with AI-written shows.

title: The Comeback
description: Valerie Cherish stars in a sitcom written by artificial intelligence, which presents her with bizarre challenges.

title: The Comeback
description: Valerie finds herself alone amid a media meltdown after news of her AI written show is somehow leaked to the public; Val is further shocked to discover that a member of her team has not signed a NDA.

description: Valerie tries to repair the damage caused by negative AI press and save Mark's reality show job by making an appearance on "Finance Dudes.".

description: Urged by NuNet to make a public statement in defense of AI, Valerie contemplates her future with or without How's That?!

title: Pitch Perfect 3
description: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart and discovering there aren't job prospects for making music with your mouth. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, the group of nerds comes together to make some music one last time.

title: Youth
description: After a surprising diagnosis, Alex deals with Ruari's graduation stunt, her ex's decision to move to Canada, and a setup with an older man.

title: Youth
description: Alex has a delicate meeting with the agency's most successful author, in addition to trying to get Ruari to open up and reconnect with Patrick.

title: Youth
description: At the Frankfurt Book Fair, Alex tries to keep Ruari occupied while being bombarded by the viral success of Malcolm's self-published novel.

title: Youth
description: Sam tasks Alex with the unpleasant job of winning Malcolm back as a client; Alex leans on Michael during a family dinner.

title: Youth
description: Alex finds herself on a couple's holiday in Ibiza with her ex-husband, ex-fling, their new girlfriends and Ruari as her plus one.

title: Youth
description: While Alex tries to make sense of her new relationship, she and Sam attempt to win back Malcom before Grayson swoops in.

title: Death of a Unicorn
description: A weekend retreat has deadly consequences when a father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route, and his billionaire boss seeks to exploit the creature's miraculous curative properties.

title: Life of the Party
description: When her husband suddenly dumps her, longtime and dedicated housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Unfortunately, Deanna winds up at the same school as her less-than-thrilled daughter. Plunging headlong into the campus experience, the outspoken new student soon finds her true self while fully embracing all the fun, freedom and frat boys that she can handle.

title: Materialists
description: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

title: Chris Fleming: Live at the Palace
description: Comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first stand-up special; a performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another, from Trader Joe's to Oreos, NPR and dog breeds; Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines and more.

title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
description: Debuting original material about the shared experiences as humans, tackling topics like family, religion and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity; expecting an original and unforgettable experience, filmed at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles.

title: The Drama
description: A confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can go ahead with the union.

title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
description: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville.

title: Green Lantern
description: Sworn to preserve intergalactic order, the Green Lantern Corps has existed for centuries. Its newest recruit, Hal Jordan, is the first human to join the ranks. The Green Lanterns have little regard for humans, who have thus far been unable to harness the powers of the ring each member wears. But Jordan, a gifted and cocky test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when a new enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

title: Smallfoot
description: Migo is a friendly Yeti whose world gets turned upside down when he discovers something that he didn't know existed -- a human. He soon faces banishment from his snowy home when the rest of the villagers refuse to believe his fantastic tale. Hoping to prove them wrong, Migo embarks on an epic journey to find the mysterious creature that can put him back in good graces with his simple community.

title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
description: Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows estranged Spinal Tap bandmates David St. Hubbins, Nigel Tufnel and Derek Smalls as they search for a drummer and prepare for a reunion concert in New Orleans. Joined by music royalty Paul McCartney and Elton John, Spinal Tap wrestles with their checkered past to put on a show they hope will solidify their place in the pantheon of rock 'n' roll.

title: Anyone But You
description: Despite an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's initial attraction quickly turns sour. However, when they unexpectedly find themselves at a destination wedding in Australia, they pretend to be the perfect couple to keep up appearances.

title: The Cabin in the Woods
description: When five college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison, Fran Kranz, Jesse Williams) arrive at a remote forest cabin for a little vacation, little do they expect the horrors that await them. One by one, the youths fall victim to backwoods zombies, but there is another factor at play. Two scientists (Richard Jenkins, Bradley Whitford) are manipulating the ghoulish goings-on, but even as the body count rises, there is yet more at work than meets the eye.

title: Saltburn
description: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.
